data.name: Md. Masud Mazumder
data.intro:
I am an MSc. student in Computer Science, supervised by Dr. Shaiful Chowdhury in the SQM Research Lab.

My work sits at the meeting point of software quality and machine learning — using models to understand and improve the code we ship, and asking what changes when part of the author is a machine. My thesis focuses on software vulnerability.

I am looking for PhD opportunities in software engineering and applied machine learning.
